description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

name: epics-pane
description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

name: error-meter
description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

name: exit-badge
description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

name: explore-pack
description: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check. They read git and project files. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: file-links
description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

name: file-owners
description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: files-pane
description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

name: focus-pack
description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

name: fun-pack
description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

name: git-history-guard
description: Asks before git commands that throw away work or rewrite history: reset --hard, clean, rebase, filter-branch, filter-repo, push --delete, branch -D and stash clear.

name: git-pane
description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

name: gitignore-check
description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked. Checks with git ls-files.

name: gitmoji-commits
description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.

name: guard-devops
description: Asks before harsh DevOps commands: destructive Docker, Kubernetes and Helm calls, CI config edits, broad chmod and chown, and git commands that lose work. Add infra-guard for plain kubectl delete.

name: guard-essentials
description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. Reads git. The quiet choice for daily work.

name: haiku-commits
description: Commit messages get a normal conventional-commit first line, then a 5-7-5 haiku about the change in the body.

name: handoff
description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: heatmap
description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

name: hotspots
description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: infra-guard
description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

name: issue-links
description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

name: json-pretty
description: Bash output that is one long line of JSON is drawn pretty-printed, folded after 30 lines. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

name: junior-mode
description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.

name: k8s-guard
description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

name: langs
description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

name: latte-meter
description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.

name: licenses
description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: lifecycle-pack
description: The four original lifecycle mods in one: runs your formatter, sends ntfy.sh pushes for long commands and input waits, and appends to ~/.claude/journal.log.

name: loc
description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: lockfile-guard
description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.

name: lockfile-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.

name: long-run-notify
description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when a Bash command ran longer than a threshold (60 seconds by default). Sends the project name and the seconds only. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

name: mentor-pack
description: Mentor habits in one install: a hint and a guiding question first, assumptions listed before work, and a strict self-review after each change.

name: migration-guard
description: Asks before Write or Edit changes a migration that already exists; new migration files pass.

name: migration-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.

name: model-badge
description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).

name: mood-ring
description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

name: night-owl
description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

name: no-em-dash
description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

name: no-sycophancy
description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.

name: no-verify-guard
description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).

name: noir-mode
description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

name: notify-pack
description: Local alerts in one: a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input (osascript or notify-send), and a spoken line (say) on macOS when a long turn ends.

name: now-playing
description: A band above the prompt with the track Music or Spotify plays on your Mac (♪ Song - Artist), read with pgrep and osascript once a minute, only from a player that runs. Hidden when nothing plays.

name: ntfy-notify
description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

name: nudge-pack
description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

name: ops-band
description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

name: package-guard
description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.

name: path-jail
description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

name: path-shorten
description: Tool rows draw long absolute file paths shorter: the project root as ./ and your home folder as ~. Display only; Bash commands are drawn as they ran.

name: personal-bests
description: Tracks your records across sessions (longest session, most tool calls in a session, most files edited in a day, cheapest session over 30 minutes), toasts a new one, and lists them with /bests.

name: pirate-mode
description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.

name: plain-english
description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.

name: pomodoro
description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

name: port-watch
description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

name: pr-description
description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master, read with git. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: priority-bar
description: A band above the prompt with your open beads by priority (P0 2 · P1 14 · P2 60 · P3 50), red while a P0 is open, read with bd count every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.

name: process-pane
description: A live side pane of the processes the session's Bash calls started that still run, with pid, age and command. Read-only: one ps every 5 seconds. Open it with /procs.

name: prod-db-guard
description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.

name: protect-main
description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master. Reads the branch with git.

name: publish-guard
description: Asks before a package is published: npm, pnpm, yarn or bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry or uv publish. Dry runs pass.

name: quality-pack
description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.

name: readme-check
description: Adds /readme-check: missing README sections (install, usage, licence, contributing) and broken relative links, at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: ready
description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

name: receipt
description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

name: recent
description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: registry-push-guard
description: Asks before an image or chart is pushed to a registry: docker push, docker buildx --push, podman push, helm push, gcloud artifacts docker push. Local registries pass.

name: release-pack
description: Asks before a release leaves your machine: package publish, tag push, production deploy and registry push guards in one mod. The tag guard reads tags with git.

name: render-pack
description: Both original rendering mods in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies (a click puts @path in the prompt).

name: render-plus
description: Three row badges in one: time-badge, exit-badge and size-badge.

name: reply-language
description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.

name: repo-pack
description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: reviewer-mode
description: After each code change, reviews its own diff like a strict senior reviewer and lists each issue it found and fixed.

name: rubber-duck
description: Restates the problem in its own words and lists its assumptions before it starts work.

name: say-done
description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

name: scripts
description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: secret-commit-guard
description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file. Reads the staged diff with git.

name: secret-filename-guard
description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

name: secret-guard
description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

name: secret-output-guard
description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

name: secret-scan
description: Adds /secret-scan: tracked files and line numbers that hold secret-shaped text, found with git grep. Never prints a matched value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: security-mode
description: Checks each change for injection, secrets, authorization and unsafe input, and states the risks it checked.

name: session-clock
description: A band above the prompt with the wall clock and how long the session has run (14:05 · 1h 12m).

name: session-journal
description: Appends one line per session end (time, directory, reason) to ~/.claude/journal.log.

name: sha-links
description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

name: shakespeare-mode
description: Prose in Early Modern English flair. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

name: ship-safe-pack
description: The release-pack guards plus db-reset-guard and upload-guard: asks before publish, tag push, production deploy, registry push, database wipes and file uploads. Reads tags with git.

name: size
description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: size-badge
description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

name: slack-notify
description: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

name: socratic-mode
description: For learning: answers a question with a short hint and one guiding question first, and gives the full answer when you ask. Code and commands stay exact.

name: sounds-arcade
description: Arcade blips: a coin when tests pass, a game-over drop when they fail, a buzz when a call is blocked, a power-up when a turn ends.

name: sounds-minimal
description: Very short, quiet clicks and ticks for a subtle signal: a tick when tests pass, two low ticks when they fail, a click when a call is blocked, a soft tick when a turn ends.

name: sounds-nature
description: Soft nature sounds: a bird chirp when tests pass, a plunk into water when they fail, a gust of wind when a call is blocked, a water drop when a turn ends.

name: sounds-office
description: Quiet office sounds: a soft click when tests pass, a low thud when they fail, paper when a call is blocked.

name: sounds-retro
description: 8-bit sounds: a coin when tests pass, a buzz when they fail, a chime when a turn ends.

name: sounds-scifi
description: Sci-fi console sounds: a beep when tests pass, an alarm when they fail, a warp when a turn ends.

name: sounds-zen
description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

name: sports-narrator
description: One line of sports play-by-play at turn end. OFF by default: one haiku call per turn with tools. Turn on the enabled option. Sends tool names, file names and the first two words of each command.

name: ssh-guard
description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

name: standup
description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

name: stashes
description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: stats-pack
description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

name: ste-mode
description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

name: streak-flame
description: A band above the prompt with your daily streak, the days in a row you finished a turn (🔥 5d). The mod keeps the count in its own store.

name: streaks
description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

name: sudo-guard
description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

name: tag-guard
description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

name: tdd-mode
description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

name: team-pack
description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

name: terse-mode
description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

name: time-badge
description: Tool rows show how long the call ran, for example 2.4s, when it took over one second. The time is the tool's own run time, without permission prompts.

name: timeline-pane
description: A live side pane of this session's turns, newest first: start time, length, tool calls and cost of each, with a total. Open it with /timeline.

name: todo-count
description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

name: todo-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

name: todo-pane
description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

name: todos
description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: tool-counter
description: A band above the prompt with your tool calls this session, the top three by tool (Bash 41 · Edit 18 · Read 12).

name: tree
description: Adds /tree: tracked files (git ls-files) as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: turn-timer
description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

name: typecheck-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when .ts or .tsx files were edited and no type check (tsc, vue-tsc, a typecheck script or a build) ran since the last edit.

name: upload-guard
description: Asks before local files go to a remote host: scp or rsync to host:path, piped input to nc, curl -T, sftp put. Local copies, downloads and localhost pass.

name: url-links
description: https links (and http://localhost) in tool output are listed as clickable links under the result, up to five. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

name: weekly
description: Adds /week: this week (since Monday) against last week, with sessions, turns, tool calls, files edited and cost, and the change for each.

name: wrapped
description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

name: yoda-mode
description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

name: live-recap
description: A card above the prompt that says what Claude is working on, refreshed every few minutes while a turn runs

name: message-timestamps
description: Prefixes each Claude reply in the transcript with the local time it arrived, with no model calls

name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires, so returning does not re-write the full context

name: korkmaz-trail
description: An audit trail for your AI agent, above the Claude Code prompt: commands, file changes, outbound calls and risky actions next to your plan limits, context and cost.

name: agents-panel
description: Side pane listing this project's agents with a run button each; /agents-panel toggles it.

name: context-bar
description: Context window breakdown and prompt-cache countdown above the prompt; /context-bar toggles it.

name: pdpa-thai
description: Helps reduce personal data sent to Claude: redacts detected Thai and international personal data before sending and masks it on screen. Detection runs locally and the mod makes no network calls of its own; the redacted conversation is…

name: prototype-mode
description: Flag a project for prototype mode: no git worktrees, iterate and commit directly on the current branch (main included). Works for background jobs too.

name: worktree-terminal
description: Open a terminal in the session's worktree or any agent's worktree: /term, or the buttons above the prompt

name: cockpit
description: Progress bars from your todo list at zero extra tokens, and a router where you pick the model and effort for quick, normal and hard prompts

name: tangents
description: Go off on a tangent about any paragraph of Claude's replies, kept out of the main context until you promote it

name: pr-watch
description: Above the prompt: the branch PR with its checks and failing log lines, uncommitted work with a commit-and-push key, and how far the branch is behind the default branch with a rebase key. The branch name sits in the hint line.

name: jev
description: Typed decisions as a noun: adds $.jev in the engine.create fold, so any plugin asks Jev a map of Choice, Score and Noul questions over one state and reads calibrated probabilities back — through the TypeSafe API, OpenRouter, Vercel AI…

name: dotnet-workflow-kit
description: A budgeted plan-to-review delivery workflow for .NET teams: start, plan, implement, test, review and next, with plan and review pages as Claude Artifacts, tailored by one profile file, with a live progress bar above the prompt.

name: ato-guard
description: In the ATO repository only: masks TFNs, ABNs, bank details and Xero/Bearer tokens in tool results, blocks Xero API and SBR/lodgement writes, refuses other mods that rewrite tool calls or prompts, and keeps a local audit of counts only

name: fleet-guard
description: Keeps subagents and agent-team teammates on allowed models (FLEET_GUARD_MODELS) and caps concurrent teammates (FLEET_GUARD_MAX_TEAMMATES); inert when both are unset

name: mc-lane
description: Reports this Claude Code lane's tool calls (names and timings only), context use and cost to Mission Control

name: mission-control
description: Read-only Mission Control fleet view: /mc pane (machines, heartbeat age, open claims, recent ships) and a fleet_status tool

name: synthex-main-status
description: In CleanExpo/Synthex sessions, shows a status line while Synthex main CI is red (read-only gh run list every two minutes)

name: cc-fm-mod
description: claude.fm in your prompt: a live spectrum under the composer and /fm to control the cc-fm player, local or over SSH

name: continue-session
description: Gives Claude a continueInNewSession(prompt) tool: /clear, then start the fresh session with that prompt.

name: dagyard
description: Dagyard en Claude Code: lo que te espera y lo que está para tomar sobre el prompt, el menú /dagyard y un aviso cuando algo nuevo te espera

name: clima-condor
description: Clima, sol y luna reales, marea, huracanes y relojes en un panel de Claude Code: /clima

name: compound
description: Checks for existing work before a substantial task, and has the lesson written down after a problem is solved.

name: classify-hint
description: Classifies the user's prompt with Haiku against a few yes/no questions in one call and attaches a rough, non-binding hint for the main agent

name: verify-reports
description: Attaches a verification reminder to every delivery from another agent: a subagent's hand-back, a background task's notification, another session's message

name: usage-wrapup
description: When your plan usage gets low, tells every running agent to wrap up before the limit cuts it off.

name: are-you-sure-bro
description: Mod: confirms risky Bash commands; offers to cap output of noisy ones

name: matchmaker
description: Mod: classifies each prompt (cheap model) and tells Claude which agent/model fits; band with off switch

name: stop-you-violated-the-law
description: Mod: STOP! You violated the law! toast when opus is used for a light turn

name: your-call
description: Choice UI tool (select, multi, rank, compare matrix, wizard, regenerate), in-thread charts from fenced viz blocks, plus skills ask-dont-guess, show-dont-tell, phone-a-friend and ask-the-audience

name: council
description: Second opinions inside Claude Code: GPT as fresh eyes when you go in circles, Codex acceptance of every handover, and Codex+Claude review of each change.

name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

name: avatars
description: Claude speaks a short version of each reply through ElevenLabs, as a narrator or a cast of characters with animated portraits above the prompt

name: cc-pokedex
description: Catch wild creatures above the Claude Code prompt: where your prompt leads (water, grass, fire, bugs, plans, builds) decides what appears. Pick a partner that draws under the logo, beside the spinner and above the prompt, and levels up…

name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code and Codex sessions.

name: mascot
description: A desktop mascot overlay that reacts to turns, tool calls and subagents

name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and subagent and main-loop effort at turn.step, with optional main-loop model routing. Falls back to the engine's built-in…

name: jev-route
description: Routes each turn to the cheapest capable Claude model using Jev, TypeSafe's decision model. Toggle with /route.

name: terminal-gym
description: A daily bodyweight rep goal inside Claude Code: log with /fit, quick-log band, long-turn nudges, streaks and a score grid, optional strict mode.

name: fleet
description: See every running Claude Code session and worktree at a glance: status, branch, uncommitted work, staleness

name: status-band
description: A designed status band under the prompt: model and effort, directory, git, a context gauge, the 5-hour and weekly quota you have left, and cost.

name: red-alert
description: Audible alerts for Claude Code: Claude sounds normal/yellow/red alerts on your server's speakers, with an LCARS status band and alert animations.

name: starfleet-panel
description: An LCARS status panel under the Claude Code prompt, in the style of a 24th-century Starfleet console; follows red-alert's alert condition.

name: codex-flow
description: /flow 面板查看和停止本会话派出的 Codex 任务，任务跑满 15 分钟时提醒主 Agent 排查

name: compact-jev
description: /compact-jev: Jev-guided verbatim compaction for Claude Code, called through Vercel AI Gateway. Never replaces /compact or auto-compaction.

name: sessions
description: Ett band ovanför prompten: varning innan promptcachen går kall, och (pausad) en översikt över alla Claude-sessioner på maskinen

name: burn-baby-burn
description: Nags you, with fire, when much of your weekly usage limit is still unspent close to the reset

name: diff-review
description: git の差分を GitHub の Changes のようにペインで見て (split / unified)、行を選んでコメントし、まとめて Claude に渡す mod

name: engram-status
description: Estado del sync de Engram en la línea de estado, con una franja de aviso solo cuando algo falla

name: cache-timer
description: A countdown to when the conversation's prompt cache expires, in the prompt footer before the model name

name: context-band
description: A band above the prompt with rate limits, tokens, speed, cache, cost and context fill, in light and dark themes

name: usage-band
description: Usage band above the prompt: limits with projection, context, tokens, speed, cost, turns, tools, churn, agents, model, effort, folder, git and memory, each one switchable

name: subagents-monitor
description: Live side pane listing the session's subagents: status, elapsed and working time, model, effort and estimated cost.

name: statusline-native
description: In-session Client TUI for statusline configuration

name: bouncer
description: Bouncer for Claude Code: enforce condition-based markdown guardrail rules on tool calls — deny or annotate any call whose content matches, instead of file-path-only rules.

name: pet
description: Maid mascot in the prompt band: reacts to Claude state, shows CTX/5H/7D usage, keeps an affection counter.

name: session-pings
description: Mac notifications titled with the session name, saying what Claude needs from you: done, a question, or a permission. Works out of the box; install terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier) to make notifications clickable, which…

name: xray
description: xray-spinners: glanceable cards under the spinner showing what Claude is doing, what is left on its plate, and how the task stands

name: chronicle
description: Write and guard your project's history — craft commits (auto simple/atomic), author reviewer-legible PRs/MRs, cut config-first releases, and promote cockpit decisions into ADRs.

name: dispatch
description: Plan before you fly — interview-driven specs you can execute. preflight captures what you want as INTENT.md before any solution is chosen; hop interviews, plans, and executes a small scope in one session; flightplan writes a multi-file…

name: guard
description: Turn coding rules into harness-enforced ones. comment-guard (each Edit/Write) and comment-sweep (at Stop, for writes that bypassed them) hand back the comment blocks of three or more lines the agent added or grew, with one question: is…

name: monitor
description: Monitor your Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode sessions — a usage dashboard plus a per-project cockpit with a decision trail, live session view, needs-your-call bridge, and thoughtful auto-logging.

name: runes
description: Runes, switchable UI mods for Claude Code. First rune: Clawd, hey-clawd's pixel crab, animating above the prompt. Toggle with /runes.

name: usage-meter
description: Plan usage under the prompt: 5-hour, weekly and Fable limits with reset times, plus prompt-cache expiry

name: cc-range
description: A first-person pixel-art shooting gallery above the Claude Code prompt: thirty-second rounds, targets that shrink and drift, eight rotating backdrops, and a chiptune. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

name: stepwarden
description: Every tool call your agent makes, checked before it runs. Verifies each pending tool call against the session's plan using TypeSafe AI's Jev model, then allows it, asks you, or blocks it.

name: cc-mod-waitwhat
description: Buttons above the prompt: retell recent turns in plain words, or open what a background check flagged that you might miss. Results go to Claude Code's own pane; nothing enters the transcript or the model's context.

name: cc-dino
description: The T-rex from the browser's offline page, above the Claude Code prompt: jump cacti and duck birds while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

name: task-planner
description: Recomienda modelo, effort y subagentes al empezar una tarea nueva y aplica la eleccion en silencio.

name: chottag
description: Drive chottag (c-hottag) from Claude Code: switch the serving account, set the remote account, log accounts in, check limits and the install. On Claude Code 2.1.287+ a mod adds a status card, notices, /ct commands and a /login guard.

name: eta
description: Time left on the working turn, on the spinner line: from the task list's pace, else from how long your turns run. No model calls, no tokens. /eta turns it on or off.

name: agentille
description: Personal AI coding orchestrator for Claude Code (trigger: /agt). See your agents work: a live band above the prompt and a pixel team deck show every agent's role, model, effort, state and tokens. A routing mod enforces model + effort per…

name: sandcastle
description: Shows a live sandcastle run in the Claude Code session: a row above the prompt, a notice when a ticket needs a person, and a prompt when the run ends; between runs, a quiet idle mark in a set-up project

name: team-orchestrator
description: Team Orchestrator: welcome screen, quick starts (Squad, All-Purpose Team, Tech Team), a table-style team form, and a live roster to spawn and manage teams of Claude Code sessions as Orca tabs.

name: workflow-toolbox
description: Toolbox for Claude Code's Workflow tool — author deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (workflow-composer, with the @workflow-toolbox compile-time pattern toolkit as its standard library), scaffold a build-clean workflow skeleton…

name: pilot-guard
description: Author, scaffold, and debug multi-agent workflows for Claude Code's Workflow tool — a skills-only plugin plus @workflow-toolbox, a compile-time TypeScript pattern library. Research preview.

name: wt-deep-search
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Answers a WebSearch from the local Claude Code doc mirror, context7, Brave or Exa, and adds a detached deep-research rung behind a handle.

name: wt-rules-on-demand
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Deliver frontmatter-triggered rules at matching prompts and tool calls.

name: wt-secret-guard
description: Function-hook secret scrubber for prompts, assistant text, tool results, and raw outbound tool inputs

name: git-guard
description: Denies Bash git commands that discard uncommitted work (checkout --, restore, reset --hard, clean -f)

name: acp-ui
description: Restyles the Claude Code terminal like an ACP chat: prompt and tool cards, inline diffs, a status band, footer stats, a /dash pane and a done toast

name: claudou
description: A Claude Code buddy: a pixel-art pet above your prompt that grows while you work and teaches you Claude Code

name: usage-band
description: Mod: a slim retro line above the prompt showing your plan's 5-hour and weekly usage limits.

name: xmuse
description: xmuse room board status: status line, toasts, pane and a status tool, plus human-approved split decisions under a short-lived plugin grant. Never holds the operator token.

name: clawd-tracker
description: A Domino's-style order tracker above the prompt. Clawd acts out every step next to an honest progress bar, a learned ETA, a delivery receipt, plan usage and a delivery ding. Themes: pizza, coffee, rocket, construction.

name: agent-cast
description: While subagents and teammates run, shows each one as a character: one row per agent in a band above the prompt (face, type, task, current tool, elapsed time), and their faces at the head of the spinner line. Each agent type has its own…

name: under-management
description: Play Under Management while Claude works on a long turn. After 20 s of work, press 1: the game opens in a 960 x 600 window of its own and pauses itself when Claude finishes.

name: better-tasks
description: Plan and track tasks inside Claude Code, kept as plain Markdown files in your project, with weekly sprints, a sprint board and agent teammates.

name: clawd-buddy
description: A cozy pixel Clawd above the prompt that acts out what Claude is doing right now, with a liveness pulse so long silent turns never look stuck.

name: pixel-office
description: Every Claude Code session as a pixel character in a shared office you can click and talk to

name: tldraw
description: Claude가 tldraw 캔버스에 그리고, Claude Code 안의 pane에서 바로 보여줍니다 (드래그 이동, 휠 확대/축소). tldraw.com 공식 MCP도 함께 연결합니다.

name: quarry
description: Adds Exa's results to WebSearch, and saves each WebFetch page to disk with the lines that answer the prompt

name: atlas
description: Adds /atlas: a file explorer in a pane beside Claude Code, with git marks, search by name or text, and micro to edit a file.

name: browse
description: Adds /browse: a web browser in a pane beside Claude Code.

name: channel
description: Your chats in a pane beside Claude Code: read, reply, and get a toast when someone messages you. iMessage today, more chat apps to come.

name: instantnotes
description: Your InstantNotes in a pane beside Claude Code: search as you type, read a note as Markdown, write one in the pane or with /note.

name: orbit
description: A globe of everything your Claude session talks to: tool calls, sockets and bytes traced to hosts, countries and orgs, with a deny-list that blocks before a call runs.

name: redline
description: A tachometer for your Claude sessions: when the needle hits the redline, stop spawning and start finishing.

name: jev-context
description: Jev-scored context pruning for Claude Code through OpenRouter: at compaction every tool call and result is scored by TypeSafe's Jev decision model, stale ones are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim. An optional gate…

name: session-title
description: Names each new session from its first prompt, e.g. "fix: resolve hook timeout on first prompt"

name: fleet-gauge
description: Weekly cap, context fill and each subagent's call count above the prompt, with a warning when an agent runs long.

name: agentzero
description: AgentZero for Claude Code: all of AgentZero, plus hot set loading and a check of the operator's words.

name: pokemon
description: Your Pokémon party journeys through a pixel world above the Claude Code prompt: it runs while Claude works, cheers when tests pass, faints when they fail, levels up and evolves.

name: statusline
description: Shows the main loop's model and its context window fill under the prompt

name: rp
description: /rp lists ReadyRig projects by machine; the picked project is appended to your next prompt

name: shire-status
description: shire index health in the status line, toasts when it changes, and a /shire pane with rebuild buttons

name: notch-crab
description: A pixel crab above your Claude Code prompt that acts out every hook (33 reactions). Thin bars beside him track the context window and your 5-hour and weekly limits. Works on its own. If the notch-crab Mac app (not released yet) is…

name: auto-checkpoint
description: Snapshots the working tree into hidden git refs at the start of every turn, with /checkpoints to list them and /undo-turn to roll back.

name: branch-guard
description: Stops Claude from editing files or running mutating git commands on main or master, and points it at a worktree instead.

name: cost-bar
description: A one-row band above the prompt with session cost, 5h/7d plan limits and an optional budget bar.

name: file-tree-pane
description: Adds /tree: a side pane with a lazy file tree coloured by git status. Press a file to put @path in the prompt.

name: notify-on-finish
description: Sends a desktop notification when a long turn finishes, so you can look away while Claude works.

name: path-guard
description: Blocks Write, Edit and MultiEdit calls that target a path outside the project root or inside .git, plus optional deny globs.

name: powerline-bar
description: A one-row powerline-style band above the prompt: directory, git branch and state, model, context fill.

name: secret-guard
description: Blocks Write, Edit and Bash calls that would put an API key, token or private key into a file or command.

name: sensitive-file-guard
description: Blocks Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob and Bash calls that touch .env files, private keys and credential stores.

name: spinner-stats
description: Adds elapsed time, the running tool and the tool-call count to Claude Code's own spinner.

name: context-bar
description: Context window bar and a live prompt-cache countdown under the prompt

name: redact
description: Redacts secrets and PII from every row Claude Code stores, before the model reads it and before the transcript keeps it. Reach L0: no network, no processes, no files.

name: jev-skill-scout
description: Before each prompt reaches the model, TypeSafe's Jev ranks your installed skills against it and attaches one line naming the skill to load. Sends the prompt text to api.typesafe.ai. Needs function hooks (early access).

name: claudeamp
description: A Winamp-style player for Claude Code: live spectrum visualizer, scrolling marquee, playlist of tool calls and transport controls.

name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort…

name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort…

name: foreman
description: Live view of a foreman program: lanes, agents, stalls, what needs you, and memory

name: better-compact
description: Steers every compaction, including automatic ones, with a brief that keeps goal, next step, files, decisions and state.

name: context-view
description: The context window as one row above the prompt, drawn the way Claude Code draws its own meters: the context's cells, the percentage used, the tokens over the window, and the tokens left before auto-compact. /context-view hides and shows it.

name: tdd-mod
description: Blocks file writes that break Red-Green-Refactor on coding tasks (port of probity's enforceTdd).

name: atelier-bell
description: Tells you when an atelier finishes: flux7-studio renders, as toasts and a line under the prompt

name: avatar7
description: A machine face that watches tool calls and comments on them, with switchable avatars

name: jukebox7
description: Plays music from YouTube when asked in plain words, audio only through ffplay, with a small control pane

name: mesh7-pane
description: Live mesh7 decisions, pending approvals and emergency stops in a pane

name: usage-bell
description: Rings when the session nears a limit: context fill, rate-limit windows, the auto-memory index

name: image-view
description: See the images you paste into Claude Code: thumbnails above the prompt, drawn with real pixels in kitty and Ghostty (and iTerm2 with CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES=1), and as half-block thumbnails everywhere else.

name: inline-headroom
description: Headroom-style levers inside Claude Code as a mod: clamp-only effort routing after successful tool results, and a detector-only CacheAligner that flags volatile system-prompt content and cache-hit drops. Ships a host-wide SQLite storage…

name: desktop-look
description: Make the terminal transcript look like the Claude Code desktop app: prompt bubbles, tool cards and an info band

name: agent-hub
description: Agent hub: a pane listing this session's subagents with status, model, turns and tokens, and a box to steer a running one.

name: auto-effort
description: Auto effort: the decision model rates each prompt and the turn it starts runs at that effort.

name: compact-methods
description: oh-my-pi compaction methods: shake (move old tool output to files, no model call) and handoff (continue from a handoff document). Use `/compact shake` or `/compact handoff [focus]`.

name: decision-model
description: A decision model for other mods ($.decision.ask): typed questions about a state, answered by any System One endpoint (Jev by default) or a small Claude model.

name: eval-kernel
description: A persistent JavaScript kernel the model drives with one `eval` tool: state survives between cells, and cells call Claude Code tools, models and subagents.

name: resume-on-stop
description: Unexpected stops: when a turn ends right after saying it will act, the decision model spots it and one turn resumes the work.

name: ttsr-rules
description: oh-my-pi TTSR rules: a regex rule denies the tool call that would break it, with the rule as the reason; a question rule is judged after each turn.

name: cross-review-status
description: Band above the prompt showing the state of every cross-review review and consult this session has started

name: sleight
description: Unofficial: lets Claude drive macOS apps in the background through the computer-use engine bundled with the ChatGPT desktop app, without taking over your cursor.

name: agents-skills
description: Discover Agent Skills under .agents/skills (project) and ~/.agents/skills (user), expose them as slash commands, list them in prompt.context, and optionally intercept the Skill tool so names from those trees load without living under…

name: cc-subway
description: Subway runner in a pane on the right of the Claude Code transcript: three lanes, jump, roll, dodge trains, collect coins while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

name: cc-traj-seg
description: Trajectory segmentation for long Claude Code sessions: every N steps a model of your choice (haiku by default) reads the previous segments and the last 40 steps and either adds a segment of what Claude is doing now and the path it is on…

name: nes-pane
description: Play NES ROMs with real pixels, keyboard controls and automatic saves inside Claude Code's own pane

name: pacman
description: /pacman: Pac-Man played over the conversation on screen, eating it character by character while Claude works; Esc puts it back. Needs function hooks (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1).

name: lumberroom-memory
description: lumberroom as Claude Code's memory: the digest in the system prompt, a periodic search-and-write reminder, optional per-prompt recall, built-in memory off.

name: clawd-gotchi
description: Bottom-left retro RPG companion: a pet fed by cache hits and commits, failing test suites as bosses.

name: context-cache
description: Bottom-grid row: context fill and prompt cache (hit rate, countdown from the TTL the API reports). Toasts when context is full or the cache expired.

name: llm-speed
description: Band showing avg time to first token and output tokens/s

name: model-band
description: Band above the prompt: current model and reasoning effort.

name: rtk-quota
description: Band showing rtk gain: tokens saved and quota preserved

name: usage-tracker
description: Bottom-grid row: plan and session/week usage. Toasts when limits near.

name: clear-resume
description: Write a handover when a Claude Code session gets long, type /clear, and the next session picks up where you left off with nothing to paste.

name: skillmon
description: Records every skill use with the skillmon CLI

name: severance-mdr
description: Macrodata Refinement while your agents work: find the scary numbers and bin them.

name: segmem
description: Segmented, scoped memory for agents: one file, SQLite, no daemon. Wake at session start, recall on every prompt, staleness nag at stop.

name: bench
description: Measures a command: warmup and timed runs, median/p95/stddev and outliers, two commands compared or a saved baseline per project, and a pane with a block distribution plot. Bounded, one at a time, never during Claude's turn unless Claude…

name: best-of-n
description: Runs 2-4 attempts at a task in parallel git worktrees, each with a different approach; compare their diffs and adopt the best.

name: bisect
description: Finds the commit that broke something: git bisect with your test command in a temporary worktree (your working tree is never touched), live progress in a pane, the culprit with its diff stat handed to Claude.

name: canvas
description: Gives Claude a screen to draw on: SVG diagrams and Markdown reports in a Canvas pane with history.

name: council
description: More than one mind: ask several models at once and get a synthesis, critique the last answer, and let Claude consult another model.

name: data-peek
description: Look into CSV, TSV, JSON and JSON Lines files without dumping them into context: schema, stats, rows, filters, group counts and single-row lookups, exact and compact, streamed with caps; a /peek pane with column sparklines.

name: gh-inbox
description: GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane — one press to have Claude work on an issue or review a PR — plus the current branch's PR checks in the status line.

name: http-lab
description: An HTTP tool for API work: status, timing, trimmed headers and a body shaped to fit; localhost runs freely, other hosts ask once a session; an /http pane of the session's requests with replay and copy-as-curl.

name: plan-board
description: A live plan Claude posts and keeps current: progress above the prompt, the full checklist and its history in a pane.

name: recall
description: Search this project's past sessions: /recall for you (attach an old exchange to your next prompt), a tool for Claude to look up earlier decisions.

name: repo-map
description: A compact, cached map of the repository for Claude: files by folder with sizes and each source file's symbols with line numbers, sized to a token budget, instead of reading files to get its bearings.

name: slim
description: Shrinks the context without losing the conversation: bulky old tool results become one-line stubs, every message stays word for word.

name: spec-runner
description: Works through a Markdown checklist item by item: one prompt per item, an optional check command, the box ticked when it passes.

name: swarm
description: Splits a task into independent parts, runs them as parallel subagents you launch and watch live, then hands their results back for integration.

name: watchdog
description: Runs your dev server or watcher for the session, flags its errors above the prompt, and lets Claude read its output.

name: auto-retry
description: Keeps long sessions going through API errors and rate limits: resubmits after a backoff when idle, waits out rate limits with a countdown, never loops, and stops the moment you type.

name: ci-autopilot
description: CI that fixes itself with your say-so: watches the branch's workflow run after a push, puts a failure with its error-dense log on the band with Fix it, surfaces new review comments, and can pre-review PRs you are asked to review.

name: daily-brief
description: The first session of your day starts with a briefing: what changed since you left, what waits on you, your work in flight, a first step and a standup draft.

name: dep-sentinel
description: Audits the project's dependencies once a day in the background (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip-audit, cargo audit) and flags high-severity vulnerabilities above the prompt, with details and a one-press safe upgrade by Claude.

name: env-doctor
description: Catches a broken dev environment before Claude trips on it: wrong Node/Python/Go versions, missing node_modules, .env gaps, merges or rebases in progress.

name: follow-ups
description: The things Claude told you to do yourself, never lost: captured from answers, kept per project, mirrored to .claude/follow-ups.md, one press to finish, snooze or hand back to Claude.

name: fresh-start
description: Notices when a session is getting heavy (full context, repeated compactions, slow turns, tool errors), prepares a handoff in the background, and offers a one-press fresh start that continues from it.

name: idle-compact
description: Compacts the conversation while you are away, a few idle minutes in and before the prompt cache goes cold, instead of in the middle of your work.

name: lesson-learner
description: Claude gets better at your project without you writing rules: your corrections and the command errors Claude fixes become one-press lessons for CLAUDE.md.

name: night-shift
description: Works your backlog while you are away: when idle, one worker at a time implements the next .claude/backlog.md task in its own git worktree under a strict tool policy and budget; in the morning you review, adopt or discard each branch.

name: pair-watcher
description: Claude knows what you changed between turns: files edited outside Claude are named (with small diffs) beside your next prompt, and an optional cheap review flags slips in your own edits.

name: auto-context
description: Say "this error", "the tests", "this file", "what you just did" or "the plan" and what it points at goes along with your prompt: the failing output, the test failures, the file, the diff, the plan. No model calls, size-capped, never…

name: auto-continue
description: Keeps work flowing: when Claude stops mid-task ("Next I'll…") or asks an obvious yes ("Shall I continue?"), a 5-second countdown you can stop sends a short continue. Never for choices, missing info or risky steps.

name: auto-polish
description: Every prompt you type gets a quiet second read: without changing your words, a hidden note gives Claude the goal in one line, the likely scope, the project's checks to keep green, and what done means. Haiku only for vague prompts; See…

name: auto-review
description: A quick second pair of eyes after edits: reviews the turn's diff in the background and offers to fix what it finds.

name: lint-feedback
description: Runs your linter on every file Claude edits and hands the errors back with the edit's result, so Claude fixes them right away.

name: loop-breaker
description: Notices when Claude is stuck repeating itself (same failing call, same output, edit flip-flops, failure streaks) and tells it to change approach.

name: queue
description: A prompt queue that runs itself: line up prompts with /queue and they run one after another, pausing when Claude asks you something or a turn fails.

name: rebound
description: Sharper retries after a failed turn: when checks still fail, Claude gives up, errors loop, or you say "that didn't work", haiku drafts a retry with the lesson, a different approach and the exact failing output. One click sends it.

name: stub-detector
description: No lazy placeholders: flags TODOs, '... rest of code', NotImplemented stubs and empty bodies an edit introduces, nudges Claude to finish them, and lists what is left.

name: task-splitter
description: One prompt, several jobs: when a prompt you type holds independent tasks (a list, numbered steps, "do A, then B, and also C"), offers to run them one by one as their own turns, stopping at the first that fails or asks you something.

name: turn-governor
description: Caps runaway turns: asks, stops or warns when one turn passes a step, time or cost limit.

name: verify-loop
description: Runs your project's checks after Claude edits, shows pass/fail above the prompt, and closes the loop with one-press (or automatic, bounded) fixes.

name: mod-manager
description: The Gobworks manager: browse every mod by category, see what each does and costs, turn mods and presets on or off, and check them. Best standalone in any terminal (gobworks); inside a running Claude Code session too (/mods).

name: achievements
description: A little game layer: 32 achievements for how you use Claude Code, with lifetime progress and a /achievements pane.

name: arcade
description: Something to do during long turns: /snake and /2048 in a pane, with high scores and a nudge when Claude is done.

name: gob-pet
description: Gob as a Tamagotchi-style companion who lives off your work: finished turns, green tests and commits grow him, and /pet lets you feed, play with, pet, nap and dress him. Free, and he never punishes you.

name: narrator
description: Opt-in: after a long turn, hear one spoken sentence about what Claude did.

name: notify
description: A chime, a toast and an optional webhook when Claude finishes a long turn or needs your permission.

name: spinner-themes
description: Themed words for the waiting line (pirate, space, kitchen, ...) plus live output speed and step count.

name: timestamps
description: Shows when you sent each prompt ([14:32]) and when each turn finished.

name: jev
description: Jev (TypeSafe's System One model) as Claude's instant co-processor: bulk filter/classify/rank/semantic-grep tools, risk notes under permission dialogs, a check on unverified 'it passes' claims, and optional per-prompt effort.

name: jev-autopermit
description: Opt-in instant approval for clearly harmless shell commands: a strict pre-filter, then Jev classifies the command; only read-only inspection at ≥ 97% with no network risk skips the permission dialog. Every approval is logged.

name: jev-comments
description: No narrating comments: every comment an edit adds is judged by Jev in a few hundred ms; 'Added X as requested' and friends go back to Claude.

name: jev-conventions
description: Instant repo-convention checks on every edit: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, style guides and config facts compiled into atomic rules, each edit judged against all of them by Jev in a few hundred ms.

name: jev-docdrift
description: Docs that went stale because of this turn's changes: changed names, flags, env vars and config keys are looked up in the docs, and Jev reads each section against the new code.

name: jev-express
description: Reflexes: short read-only requests (git status, diff stat, recent commits, cost, context) answered locally in an Express pane, no model turn.

name: jev-judge
description: A definition of done Jev checks after every turn: per-criterion probabilities that demand evidence, a band above the prompt, optional auto-continue.

name: jev-mood
description: Claude adapts to how you are doing: Jev reads each prompt's tone in a blink and, when the signal is strong, hands Claude one hidden line of guidance. Silent by default.

name: jev-ping
description: Notifications only when you are actually needed: after each turn Jev reads whether Claude asks you something, is stuck, or finished a long task; permission prompts ping too. Toast, chime, optional webhook.

name: jev-precommit
description: A commit gate that reads the staged diff in a blink: Jev flags debug output, commented-out code, TODOs, machine paths, secrets and off-message changes before Claude's git commit runs.

name: jev-reuse
description: "This helper already exists": new functions are compared against a git-grep symbol index, Jev judges the look-alikes in a few hundred ms, and Claude hears about duplicates.

name: jev-scope
description: Keeps changes on task: every edit is judged by Jev against your last request (and Claude's plan) in a few hundred ms; drive-by changes go back to Claude.

name: jev-scout
description: Jev ranks every file in the repo against each prompt in ~0.5 s and hands Claude the likely relevant ones (System-1 file triage).

name: jev-seclint
description: An instant security reviewer on every code edit: ~20 yes/no checks per edit answered by Jev in a few hundred ms, fed back to Claude.

name: jev-topic
description: Jev notices when a prompt starts an unrelated task and offers a fresh conversation for it, saving context and prompt cache.

name: jev-triage
description: Every failed Bash/PowerShell command gets an instant Jev diagnosis (15 failure classes) and a playbook in this project's terms, as a note Claude reads.

name: jev-trim
description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs cut to the lines that matter: Jev scores every 12-line chunk against your request, the full log is saved for Claude to open.

name: compact-keeper
description: Compaction without amnesia: archives the full transcript before each compaction and tells the summarizer to keep paths, decisions, preferences, TODOs and working commands.

name: file-radar
description: What Claude touched this session: reads, edits (+/− lines), searches per file, main vs subagent, with flags for blind edits and repeated reads.

name: git-panel
description: Git at a glance and in reach: a branch/changes status line, a /git pane to diff, stage, revert and commit, and Conventional Commit messages written by haiku.

name: handoff
description: /handoff writes a structured handoff (goal, state, decisions, files, next steps, gotchas, how to verify) to .claude/handoffs/; /handoff load hands it to a later session.

name: journal
description: Project memory across sessions: every few turns haiku writes what was done, decided and left open to .claude/journal.md, and new conversations start with the latest entries.

name: snapshots
description: Whole-tree time travel: a git snapshot of every non-ignored file before each turn, with diff, restore and /undo, never touching HEAD, the index or the stash.

name: clarifier
description: Ask before guessing: when a prompt looks ambiguous, Claude asks up to three clarifying questions first. Off until /clarify on.

name: context-macros
description: Inline #tokens that attach live context to a prompt: #diff, #staged, #log:20, #tree, #todo, #errors, #file:path:10-40, #url:https://...

name: effort-prefix
description: Set the effort for one prompt with a caret prefix: ^max, ^xhigh, ^high, ^med, ^low (^^ = max, ^ = high).

name: modes
description: Switchable working styles (teach, terse, pair, review, tdd, explore, ship, or your own) applied to every prompt you send.

name: pins
description: Standing context you control: pin notes and files once, and every prompt you send carries them.

name: project-primer
description: Starts every conversation oriented: one context block with the repo, branch, layout, stack and its build/test/lint/run commands, README summary and recent commits.

name: prompt-history
description: Every prompt you write, kept across sessions and projects: /history searches them and puts one back in the prompt box.

name: prompt-polish
description: Rough idea in, precise prompt out: /polish or a trailing ?? rewrites your prompt into the input box for you to edit and send.

name: prompt-stash
description: Park a half-written prompt, ask something else, and pop it back into the box later.

name: snippets
description: Text expansion in the prompt box: type ;plan and a space, get the full instruction.

name: bash-guard
description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands (rm -rf ~, curl | sh, force-push to main, DROP DATABASE, format C:) and asks before risky ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf, terraform apply), in Bash and PowerShell.

name: branch-guard
description: Keeps work off protected branches: no commit, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, am or push on main/master/release/* (or an explicit push to one), with an optional auto-branch for commits.

name: clobber-guard
description: Stops accidental truncation of real code: no "// ... rest of the code" placeholders over real code, and a question before a Write or Edit throws away most of a file.

name: package-scout
description: Supply-chain check before installs: npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/npx, pip/uv/poetry/pipx, cargo and gem packages are looked up first; nonexistent names are refused, brand-new, unpopular, deprecated or lookalike ones need your yes.

name: path-guard
description: Protected files and a project boundary: Claude can't edit .env, keys or .git, asks before touching lockfiles and migrations, and asks before writing outside the project.

name: permission-coach
description: Notices the commands you keep approving by hand and offers a one-click standing allow rule (never for risky or interpreter-wide commands).

name: readonly-mode
description: "Look, don't touch": /readonly on blocks edits and every command that is not provably read-only, and tells Claude to investigate and explain instead.

name: secret-shield
description: Keeps credentials out of your code, your shell commands and Claude's context: blocks hard-coded secrets in edits, asks before commands with literal keys, redacts secrets from tool results and flags them in prompts.

name: commit-craft
description: Commit messages in your repository's own style (learned from its last 30 subjects) and pull request descriptions from the branch, drafted by haiku; nothing is committed or pushed without a press.

name: haiku-first
description: Opt-in: questions about the codebase (where is, what does, how does, which file, find) go to a read-only haiku scout subagent first; its answer comes with Ask Claude anyway and Good enough, and the tokens saved.

name: live-ticker
description: During long turns, haiku writes one line above the prompt every ~30 s on what Claude is doing and what comes next, from a compact log of its tool calls; a one-line recap toast after turns over two minutes.

name: side-chat
description: A side conversation with haiku or sonnet in a pane, kept out of Claude's context: attach Claude's last answer, the diff, the plan or a file on demand, then send the answer or a summary to the prompt box.

name: cache-lens
description: Prompt-cache hit rate, a live warm/cold countdown, cache-bust alerts with likely causes, savings, and optional keep-warm pings.

name: context-gauge
description: Context-window gauge: a fill bar in the status line, toasts as it fills, a /ctx breakdown pane with Compact now, and optional auto-compaction between turns.

name: cost-meter
description: Spend tracking across sessions: session and today's cost in the status line, daily and weekly budgets with toasts and an optional hard stop, and a /spend pane.

name: explain-command
description: Plain English under every permission prompt: what the command does and how risky it is.

name: hud
description: One compact status line: model, context fill, cache hit and warm countdown, session cost, the fullest rate limit, and git branch with changed files.

name: rate-radar
description: Subscription rate limits at a glance: each window and its reset in the status line, toasts at 75% and 90% and when your pace beats the reset, and a /limits pane.

name: subagent-monitor
description: Every subagent, live: a /subagents pane with status, model, elapsed time, steps, tokens, last tool and answer, plus a band while any run.

name: tldr
description: A one-line TL;DR under long answers, written by haiku.

name: tool-stopwatch
description: Tool latency: times every tool call, shows a live timer for slow ones, and a /stopwatch pane with per-tool averages, p95, max and the slowest calls.

name: turn-receipt
description: A receipt for every turn: tools, tokens, cache hits, estimated cost and lines changed, on the turn's closing line (or in the transcript), with a /receipts pane.

name: usage-dashboard
description: A /dashboard pane charting this session's turns (prompt tokens by cache kind, hit rate, cost) and your last 14 days of spend.

name: agent-router
description: Picks the model for each subagent by its type (Explore on Haiku by default) and can cap how many run at once.

name: attribution
description: Your commit and pull request credit line, your way: Claude Code's default, none, or your own template with {model}.

name: autotune
description: Per-prompt effort autopilot: classifies each prompt (Jev, Claude Haiku, or heuristics) and sets that turn's effort, and optionally its model, only when the switch beats the prompt-cache rewrite it causes.

name: cache-guard
description: Asks before /model, /output-style, /fast, /effort, MCP or plugin changes and /config rows that would throw away a warm prompt cache, with the cost of rewriting it; names the rebuilds it could not prevent.

name: context-forecast
description: Forecasts how many turns remain until auto-compaction from smoothed per-turn context growth (tool output vs conversation), and at natural breaks offers Compact now with a focus Haiku drafts.

name: delta-reads
description: When Claude re-reads a file that changed since it last read it, it gets only the changed hunks (current line numbers, a few context lines) instead of the whole file.

name: output-trimmer
description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs without the context bill: Claude gets the head and tail, the full text goes to a file it can open.

name: paste-shrinker
description: Asks before sending a huge pasted log, stack trace, JSON or CSV: shrink it to a digest (head, tail, error lines) and save the full text under .claude/pastes, or send it as is.

name: prompt-inspector
description: See the system prompt section by section with sizes, and switch sections off for a project.

name: read-cache
description: Stops Claude from re-reading a file it already read in full and that has not changed since; counts the tokens saved.

name: reminder-filter
description: See the reminders and notices Claude Code injects for the model, by type and size, and mute the ones you do not want.

name: tool-diet
description: See which tools fill the prompt, grouped by MCP server, and move them behind ToolSearch (or pin them in) per project.

name: cc-dino
description: The Chrome offline dinosaur, above the Claude Code prompt. Jump the cacti and duck the pterodactyls while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

name: away-receipt
description: 離開一段時間回來時，對話旁列出離開期間發生了什麼：多久、跑了幾輪、花多少，動過的 repo、跑過的測試、做完的背景工作

name: repo-ledger
description: 提示框上方列出這個對話動過、還沒 commit 的 repo：分支、未 commit 檔案數、未 push 的 commit、別的 worktree、本輪改了幾檔

name: your-turn
description: 把最後一則回覆裡要你親手跑的指令（程式碼區塊裡 sudo 開頭的行、! <cmd>、前一句叫你自己跑的 shell 區塊）列成對話旁的清單，每段帶上回覆裡的前一句說明；按數字鍵勾完成、按 y 再按編號複製指令，全部完成後按 r 回報，送出「N/N 完成了」。只整理，不代跑

name: reins-status
description: Read-only view of the reins hold queue inside Claude Code: a status line count and a band above the prompt. It shows the queue and never answers it.

name: agent-skills-kit
description: Workflow skills, routing hooks, and read-only review subagents for Claude Code. Also portable to GitHub Copilot, Codex, OpenCode, and dsh.

name: lampboard
description: LampBoard's companion: tells the LampBoard panel on this Mac each session's context, cost and rate limits, asks LampMaster with /lampmaster, writes a handoff for another session with /handoff, answers the panel's side questions without a…

name: kiro
description: Recupera los cortes de Kiro, relanza kiro-gateway y añade /kiro.

name: context-bar
description: Context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, colored by /context category; toggle with /context-bar

name: pocock-guide
description: A side pane that keeps a beginner on Matt Pocock's flow, from grilling to retro: /mod-pocock

name: korus-fleet
description: Read-only: an opt-in status line with seat and usage, and a /fleet pane listing RUNNING seat records from the fleet script's -Json output

name: korus-inbox
description: Gathers what only the owner can act on across sessions: open questions, refusals that hand the act to the person, and owner_action signals, each with its recommended action, in an /inbox pane and an inbox N band

name: pull-request-pane
description: A pane beside the transcript with the GitHub pull requests and issues related to the current session: drag a title or description to leave a comment on it, add as many as you like, then Submit sends them all as one prompt. Watch each pull…

name: grimoire
description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Four skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders one self-contained page that reads any configuration back; groundtrack, which turns a plan or a…

name: blackjack
description: A blackjack table in a side pane to play while Claude works

name: orca
description: Autonomous multi-agent development: init/doctor once, then orca:feature from idea to integration branch, and orca:review to walk the deliverable in your own editor.

name: image-preview
description: Shows a thumbnail of each image you paste into Claude Code, instead of only [Image #1].

name: tape-club
description: Tape Club: an Apple Music cassette deck pane with a desk cat that wags to the beat

name: vn-stockmarket-heatmap
description: Live Vietnam stock-market heatmap and price board (SSI iBoard) in a Claude Code pane

name: invaders
description: A tiny Space Invaders to play above the prompt while Claude works; pauses when Claude finishes and keeps your level.

name: code-race
description: Race others at typing a line of code, right in Claude Code: start with /race (or the Race button while Claude thinks), type in your message box.

name: token-meter
description: Shows live tokens per second, per minute and per hour in the status line

name: a2a-mod
description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results.

name: ado-link-bar
description: Links in the band above the prompt to the Azure DevOps pull requests and work items mentioned most recently in the conversation.

name: ado-pr-status
description: 現在のブランチの Azure DevOps PR を裏で取得し、ccstatusline が読むファイルに書き出す

name: auto-session-title
description: Names the session with a short model-written summary of the first prompt.

name: jev
description: Jev picks the tool that fits Claude's next step and Claude gets it as a hint, shown live and measured against a control group. Native to Claude Code: no gateway, no proxy.

name: nibbl
description: Nibbl: a tiny pixel pet above your prompt that nibbles your bugs

name: factory-widget
description: The Widget Factory floor: each work order with its station and holder, what has shipped and what was turned back

name: 2048-widget
description: The 2048 sliding-tile puzzle; it plays itself until you take the keys.

name: 8ball-widget
description: Ask a yes or no question and get an answer of doubtful reliability.

name: activity-widget
description: The most recent tool calls with how long each took and whether it failed.

name: amendments-widget
description: What changed in the system prompt and the built-in tool descriptions Claude Code gives Claude since the version you last ran, with the before and after one command away

name: aquarium-widget
description: An aquarium with a fish for every running tool call and agent.

name: attic-widget
description: Counts which tools Claude calls in this project, puts the unused ones behind ToolSearch, lists the daily ones up front, and reports how many schema tokens each request no longer carries

name: badges-widget
description: Achievements earned across sessions, such as twenty tool calls in a row without a failure.

name: board-widget
description: A status board Claude keeps itself: its current goal, key findings and open questions, pinned through a tool the plugin registers.

name: boss-widget
description: A boss fight against the context window: its health drops as context fills, and compaction defeats it.

name: breakout-widget
description: A brick breaker that plays itself; every tool call adds a row of bricks.

name: campfire-widget
description: A campfire that burns higher the busier the session is and dies down to embers when idle.

name: changes-widget
description: The files edited this session, with how many edits each took.

name: checks-widget
description: The latest test, lint and build runs: whether each passed, how long it took and how long ago.

name: clocks-widget
description: Your local time beside the time zones you pick.

name: coffee-widget
description: A coffee cup that empties as you work and nudges you to take a break when it runs dry.

name: collision-widget
description: Stops an edit to a file another Claude Code session on this machine changed since this one last read it, and has Claude read it again first

name: commits-widget
description: The commits made since the session started.

name: constellation-widget
description: A night sky that gains a star each turn and joins them into a named constellation.

name: context-widget
description: The context window as a stacked bar, one colour per /context category, with six view modes.

name: countdown-widget
description: A countdown to a deadline you set, with a toast when it arrives.

name: customs-widget
description: Looks up every package Claude installs on npm or PyPI before the command runs, and holds the install for a yes when the name is missing or under 30 days old

name: diff-widget
description: The last edit as a syntax-highlighted diff.

name: done-widget
description: A definition of done you write once: Claude ticks each item with evidence through its tick tool, and is pulled up when it says done with items open

name: donut-widget
description: The spinning 3D donut, drawn in pixels; it spins faster while tool calls are running.

name: earshot-widget
description: Whether Claude has got the message you typed while it was working: how late a request first carried it, and what Claude changed before it heard you

name: equalizer-widget
description: Level meters that jump with every tool call and fall back to rest.

name: file-tree-widget
description: A file tree of the project directory with expandable folders.

name: fireworks-widget
description: A night sky that sets off fireworks when a test, lint or build run passes.

name: footnotes-widget
description: Checks every file path, cited line and code symbol in Claude's last reply against the working tree, with no model call, and flags the ones that are not there

name: forecast-widget
description: Context growth per turn as a chart, with a prediction of how many turns are left before compaction.

name: fortune-widget
description: A one-line fortune for the turn, drawn fresh each time you send a prompt.

name: garden-widget
description: A plant that grows a leaf per tool call, flowers when checks pass and wilts when a call fails.

name: git-widget
description: The current branch, how far it is ahead or behind, what is staged or changed, and the last commit.

name: guard-widget
description: A tally of this session's permission checks: what was allowed, what you were asked about and what was denied.

name: invaders-widget
description: Every failing check sends in an invader; every passing check shoots one down.

name: life-widget
description: Conway's Game of Life; every tool call drops a glider.

name: map-widget
description: A pixel map of the repository: every tracked file a block, lit blue where Claude has read and green where it has edited.

name: marquee-widget
description: An LED ticker that scrolls session events across the card: turns, tool calls and failures.

name: maze-widget
description: A first-person walk through a maze seeded by the project folder, drawn with a raycaster.

name: minesweeper-widget
description: Minesweeper, played with the mouse in the fullscreen layout.
