name: moon-widget
description: The real moon right now, drawn for your hemisphere, with a countdown to the next full moon and what it means for your deploy

name: mosaic-widget
description: A mosaic that gains one tile per tool call, coloured by tool, until the session is a picture.

name: notes-widget
description: Pinned notes that stay on screen and survive restarts; add one with /note.

name: orbit-widget
description: A small solar system whose planets speed up while tool calls are running.

name: outage-widget
description: When a push or install fails on the network, checks the provider's status page and says whether GitHub, npm, PyPI or crates.io reports an incident

name: pen-widget
description: The file, edit or command Claude is writing right now, drawn line by line as the tool call's arguments stream in, before the tool runs

name: pet-widget
description: Clawd, a pixel crab whose mood follows the session.

name: pipes-widget
description: The pipes screensaver: coloured pipes grow across the card while the session is idle.

name: pomodoro-widget
description: A focus timer: 25 minutes of work, a 5 minute break, and a count of the sessions finished.

name: premise-widget
description: Quotes thinking-summary sentences that name a gap and a choice made anyway, unless the reply flags it, and starts your correction; no model call; needs "showThinkingSummaries": true in settings.json

name: provenance-widget
description: The conversation behind a line of code: for lines Claude is about to edit, or a path:line you ask about, the prompt you typed before they were written and the command that resumes that session

name: quest-widget
description: The session as a dungeon crawl: every turn is a room, tool calls are monsters, failures wound you and passing checks drop loot. Your hero carries over between sessions.

name: queue-widget
description: A queue of prompts that run back to back while you are away, a gate command each must pass before the next starts, and a report of how each one ended

name: race-widget
description: A race track for parallel subagents: each advances one stride per tool call, with a podium as they finish.

name: rain-widget
description: Falling code rain that speeds up while tool calls are running.

name: redact-widget
description: Replaces API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in command output and file reads before Claude sees them

name: rehearsal-widget
description: Which of the commands and edits Claude has made in this project would stop for permission or be refused right now, asked of the engine's own permission check without running anything

name: seen-widget
description: The pictures Claude looked at this session, image files it read and screenshots that came back from tools, drawn as Claude received them and opened full size with one command

name: sessions-widget
description: The other Claude Code sessions open on this machine: folder, branch, and whether each is busy.

name: sigil-widget
description: A unique pixel emblem generated from each session's activity, kept in a gallery across sessions.

name: sky-widget
description: The sky at your local time of day: sun by day, moon and stars by night, more stars the longer the session.

name: skyline-widget
description: A pixel skyline: one building per turn, one floor per tool call.

name: snake-widget
description: Snake that plays itself until you take the keys.

name: sorting-widget
description: A bar chart that sorts itself one swap per tool call, then reshuffles.

name: sound-widget
description: The session as music: a note per tool call, a chord when checks pass and a buzz on failure, with a piano roll. Playback currently works on macOS only.

name: stakes-widget
description: What a yes would lose, measured from git and written under the permission dialog for a destructive command

name: stream-widget
description: A live gauge of how fast Claude is writing, in tokens per second, with a sparkline.

name: tasks-widget
description: The session's task list with a progress bar.

name: tetris-widget
description: Tetris; it plays itself until you take the keys.

name: timeline-widget
description: A chart of the turn: one bar per tool call on a time axis, parallel calls stacked, coloured by tool.

name: timer-widget
description: How long the current turn has run, with the last, average and longest turn and a sparkline.

name: todos-widget
description: The TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments in the repository, counted and listed.

name: train-widget
description: A locomotive that crosses the card pulling one wagon per tool call this turn.

name: typer-widget
description: A typing game for long turns: words fall, taken from your own file names; type them before they land.

name: usage-widget
description: A bar per rate-limit window with time to reset and session cost.

name: watch-widget
description: Reruns a command after every edit and shows a pass or fail light with the first failing lines.

name: weather-widget
description: Context usage drawn as weather, from clear skies to a storm near compaction.

name: widgets
description: Layout for the widget cards: below the prompt, above it, or docked beside the transcript. Required by every widget.

name: witness-widget
description: Every line of hidden context the other widgets add to your prompts, word for word, with a running size

name: world-widget
description: One diorama for the whole session: the sky follows the clock, the weather follows context, a tower rises per turn, a train carries the tool calls and a crab walks through it.

name: lich
description: Claude Code plugin for the lich harness

name: usage-footer
description: Footer beside the model name: prompt cache countdown and the API-equivalent cost of your 5-hour and weekly limit windows, colored by whether the limit will last. Click for a per-model token and cost breakdown.

name: usage-band
description: Always-visible Claude Code usage limits: 5-hour and weekly percentage with reset countdown, plus one-click new chat and push buttons. A Claude Code mod for the Desktop app and terminal.

name: halloween
description: Halloween theme for Claude Code: a haunted frame of pumpkins, leaves and skulls around the prompt, bats flying across the conversation, spooky spinner words, and optional spooky sounds

name: buddy
description: Buddy is back: the retired /buddy terminal companion as a Claude Code mod, with new sprites and Haiku writing its lines.

name: live-vibe
description: /live: full-duplex voice (Kyutai streaming STT with semantic end of turn, or Silero and Whisper; Kokoro TTS) through a sidecar; /vibe: director mode that delegates all work to subagents; /livevibe: talk with a fast voice front that hands…

name: spell-bar
description: An animated effort bar for Claude Code: Clawd casts Avada Kedavra at six ranks, one per effort level from low to ultracode, with Voldemort looming behind.

name: clawd-buddy
description: A small Claude Code mascot above the prompt, with usage, context, cache, directory and git status

name: devbrain-live
description: Shows what DevBrain recorded and recalled this session, in the status line under the prompt

name: leo-mods
description: Leo's Claude Code mods: usage bars, limits, cost, prompt cache countdown, active time and running agents

name: clm
description: Replaces compaction for the main conversation: older turns are folded into a ledger (goal, user instructions, done, to do, open questions, key facts) and the transcript is rewritten to the first request, the ledger and the newest turns…

name: codex-subagent
description: Agent types backed by OpenAI GPT through a per-session codex app-server daemon: the Agent tool spawns codex-subagent:gpt like any subagent, and every model step of that agent is answered by a codex thread instead of a Claude request.

description: Flags Bash commands that exit 0 but whose output shows failures, skipped tests or errors

name: task-list
description: Opt-in persistent task checklist: the agent asks to use it, the user approves, checks items off and alone can clear or disable it.

name: agent-bridge
description: Talk to OpenAI Codex from Claude Code: live peer messaging over a local pipe, plus headless delegation (ask_codex).

name: buddy
description: Claude Code buddy plugin: an ASCII companion above your prompt that remembers your rules and flags Claude's shortcuts

name: gopher-spinner
description: A pixel-art gopher that animates beside the spinner while a turn runs

name: linear-claude-mod
description: A Claude Code pane of your assigned Linear tickets by status; click one to load it into the session, read its details, comment, or change its status and priority

name: explore-model

name: review-gate
description: The review gate as a tool.check function hook. Every shell call is decided in process, so the non-commit calls -- almost all of them -- cost no subprocess at all, and a blocked commit can be put to you as a question instead of refused…

name: quality
description: Tools for reviewing code quality

description: Adds `/compact micro`: elides Read results and strips thinking, keeping the conversation structure

name: persistent-monitor
description: Monitor tool with persistent (no deadline) watches

description: Explains what Claude just did, step by step, in plain English

description: /smart-compact: write custom /compact instructions from the session, then compact with them

description: Clawd acts out the spinner's word above it while Claude works: cooking for Sautéing, dancing for Vibing, pacing for Pondering, a scene of its own for every one of the 189 spinner words. Uses none of your usage: everything is animated…

description: Claude Code mods security layer: secret redaction, untrusted-content taint, MCP tool-poisoning guard, agent-to-agent firewall, SAST findings UI, and a Jev System One classifier gateway with an explanation surface.

name: cache-timer
description: A countdown in the prompt footer: under the hint line on the terminal, left of the model picker on the desktop: time left on the prompt cache and how much of the last request it served. Olive while there is plenty, warmer at 10, 5 and 2…

name: autopilot
description: Multi-agent orchestrator harness for Claude Code: command loop, ledger, dispatch protocol, review cycle, model-economics, and a registry-driven external-worker layer.

description: When a prompt uses architecture or design words, asks Claude to answer with the system architecture as a box-drawing tree.

name: quiet-spinner
description: Plain words for the turn spinner and the turn-duration line

description: pi-style usage percentages under the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly limits

name: auto-resume

name: hud
description: Two coloured, animated lines under the prompt, every figure named: model, effort, context window, rate limits, turn timer, tool calls, agents, git state, cost, session length and folder.

name: outputs
description: A pane listing the files this session has made or changed, newest first; click one to open it.

name: quick-reply
description: One-click replies above the prompt: the options Claude just offered, Yes, Go with your recommendation, Continue.

name: turn-chime
description: Plays a sound and shows a toast when a long turn ends or Claude stops to ask you something.

name: whats-next
description: A pane in the side panel listing the next steps of your dev workflow, filled by /ask-sean; click a step to see its prompt.

name: agent-canvas
